document_title: Code of Conduct for Au Pair Organisations
notes: NOTE: This code governs au pair PLACEMENT AGENCIES (Division 78 — Employment Activities), NOT individual household employers (Division 97). Included here as the closest normative instrument touching the Div. 97 household-employer ecosystem. Sets standards for selection of au pairs and families, ethical treatment, professional conduct. ISIC primary classification: Division 78.
isic_classification_note: Properly classified: Division 78 (Employment Activities). Cross-listed here for Div. 97 household employment context.

notes: International treaty framework establishing minimum labor standards for domestic workers: rest periods, minimum wage, protection from abuse, minimum age. Adopted June 16, 2011; entered into force September 5, 2013. This is a REGULATORY/TREATY FRAMEWORK, not a professional association ethics code. Included as the best available normative framework for Div. 97. Full text also at https://www.un.org/en/development/desa/population/migration/generalassembly/docs/globalcompact/ILO_C_189.pdf
document_type_note: Treaty/convention — not a professional association code of ethics. No professional body equivalent found for household employers.
